description:
Desktop proxy client powered by Xray core.

Happ is a application designed for convenient proxy server management, powered by the robust Xray core. The app features an intuitive interface and a range of useful functions, making it an essential tool for managing connections.
• Improved the error shown when the VPN core can't be started, which now says why in the app's language
• Improved how subscription checks reach the server, using the regular connection first and the backup channel only when the server doesn't answer
• Improved the subscription log, which now explains server info codes instead of showing only a number
• Added support for packet size obfuscation settings in Hysteria2 links
• Fixed the Run button in the geo files error dialog not connecting for JSON subscriptions
• Fixed domain-based routing rules not working in Xray TUN mode for some JSON subscriptions
• Fixed a flood of connections that could exhaust network ports in Xray TUN mode
• Fixed server flags not showing with the Software graphics option
• Fixed servers with IPv6 addresses being added with a wrong address and port
• Fixed new connection settings not being applied when a subscription moves to a new address
• Fixed the Copy URL option showing for the Server List
• Fixed subscription URLs being accepted in the JSON configuration field
• Fixed missing message when connecting without a configuration
• Fixed missing reconnect notification when changing connection mode from the tray
